rv.q: A masterclass in how a Gothic novel adaptation should be done whilst adding an extra twist or two along the way.
It’s a dark, seasonal treat to experience front on and full throttle!
Tara gives a strong, spirited performance as The Governess, who is also the de facto chatelaine in the absence of a lady of the house.
With every retelling, the story changes slightly – but the sense of Gothic chill remains.
